pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/opengraph-image.doors.test.ts:11 The route claims an unfurl can never fail (opengraph-image.tsx:12), but its element tree is input for a foreign renderer (satori via next/og) that no test in the repo ever runs (both tests touching next/og mock ImageResponse), so a card satori would reject still passes every assertion.

techniques.evidence: src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/opengraph-image.doors.test.ts:11 Asserts which card element was built, the near-side check. The renderer is installed and costs about a unit test to run, yet it is replaced. A grep of all tests for next/og, satori and ImageResponse finds only mocks.

src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.unreachable.test.tsx:30 The outage test runs the real readers and the real dbReadSafe/dbReadStrict wrappers, and fakes only the Prisma client. Its header records that the earlier wholesale-mock fixture had forked from the driver and hidden the defect.

src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.unreachable.test.tsx:129 Asserts which producer answered (the typed unavailable error that reached telemetry), not only the rendered notice. Line 141 also pins that the non-strict path still degrades to null.
e2e/scan.spec.ts:92 Playwright drives /report on the real dev server and reads the result back through data-testid="report".
